sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('acm', 'cosma s p a', 'cosma', 'intertek', 'melbourn scientific trading intertek melbourn', 'patheon france', 'patheon france s a s', 'sgs france', 'evoke') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%metoclopramide%' ORDER BY initiation_date
